parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the folding chair is a flat, rectangular surface made of durable plastic, designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing body weight evenly and ensuring comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It is attached to the folding frame and can pivot upward when the chair is folded for storage.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body consists of the tubular metal frame that supports the seat and backrest, made of steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, allowing the chair to fold and unfold while maintaining balance and support.
parts.Movement_description: The base body includes pivot joints that enable folding motion, allowing the chair to collapse flat for easy storage.
